notes: Validated against Serganov et al. Cell 2008 (doi:10.1016/j.cell.2007.12.022) and Garst et al. J Biol Chem 2008 (PMC2504901). L-lysine binds at the five-helix junction; pocket completely envelops the ligand. Carboxylate: H-bonds G111-U137 wobble (via G111 N2) and G9-C76 W-C pair (via G9 N2) and G8 2'-OH. Epsilon-amino: H-bonds G111 N3 and O2', and G77 non-bridging phosphate O. Methylene chain packs against G77, A78, and the G8-G152 pair, but lysine is non-aromatic, so MacVina calibration does not list baseStacking as an expected term; this packing is a hydrophobic/shape contact outside the current aptamer terms. IRI (iridium hexamine phasing agent) stripped from receptor.
